title: The Grand Tour
theme: Directions and locations inside a large company

phrases.example: Let me walk you through the building so you can get your bearings.

phrases.meaning: figure out where you are; orient yourself
phrases.example: Let me walk you through the building so you can get your bearings.
Over there, to your left, is the reception desk.

phrases.phrase: to your left / to your right
phrases.meaning: on the left or right side of you
phrases.example: Over there, to your left, is the reception desk.
Straight ahead, past those glass doors, are the turnstiles.
It's just around the corner, next to the stairwell.
It's just around the corner, next to the stairwell.

phrases.meaning: at the most distant point of a space
phrases.example: Our pod is at the far end, by the window.
Our pod is at the far end, by the window.
Your desk is the second one on the right, directly across from mine.

phrases.meaning: across the space and to one side
phrases.example: Diagonally opposite us is the design team.
The kitchenette is down the hall, the first door on your left.

phrases.phrase: the first door on your left
phrases.meaning: the nearest door on the left side
phrases.example: The kitchenette is down the hall, the first door on your left.

phrases.meaning: facing; on the other side from
phrases.example: The restrooms are opposite the kitchenette.
The restrooms are opposite the kitchenette, hidden behind the printer.

phrases.phrase: at the end of the corridor
phrases.meaning: at the far end of the hallway

'Mekong' is at the end of the corridor, on the corner.

phrases.meaning: two levels below where you are
phrases.example: The IT help desk is two floors down, on the fifth.

Let's head up to our floor.

phrases.phrase: take the lift / take the stairs
phrases.meaning: use the elevator / use the stairs
phrases.example: Take the stairs if the lift is busy.

That's where they'll check in.

phrases.meaning: exit or emerge at a place
phrases.example: Take the stairs; they come out right next to the help desk.
Whenever you're ready, swing by my desk.

phrases.meaning: move with no clear path, often lost
phrases.example: Better to ask than to wander around lost.
Morning, Minh — welcome aboard!

phrases.meaning: get comfortable in a new place
phrases.example: Take a moment to settle in.
We'll get you set up on the systems.
A few landmarks you'll need day to day.

Don't hesitate to ask if anything's unclear.

phrases.meaning: go over the most important parts

phrases.meaning: at your own pace, no rush
